name: Neos
description: Neos by Assembly Software is cloud legal case-management software for personal-injury firms, covering intake, case lifecycle workflows, documents, deadlines, client communications, AI-assisted drafting and review, reporting, settlement tracking, and firm operations.
agentUseSummary: Neos is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Assembly Software publicly describes Neos as an API-driven developer platform and runs an Integration Partner Program with safe development environments and vetting before integrations go live, but the reviewed public materials do not publish the concrete API contract Relay needs: partner enrollment terms, authorization model, production and test origins, scopes, endpoint schemas, tenant binding, rate limits, audit requirements, or live acceptance criteria. Relay will not use partner marketing pages, status-page APIs, browser sessions, credentials, or provider consoles as a substitute for an approved Neos integration contract.

capabilities.label: Coordinate personal-injury case operations
capabilities.description: Preview a future Assembly-approved, exact-firm-authorized, least-privilege integration surface without assuming access to identity, client, case, document, communication, AI, settlement, financial, or reporting records.

blocked.label: Connect without an Assembly Neos partner contract
blocked.description: Relay will not accept or mint credentials until Assembly approves Relay as an integration partner and supplies the exact authorization model, production and safe-development origins, scopes or permissions, tenant binding, token lifecycle, rate limits, audit requirements, and live acceptance process.

blocked.label: Access identity, client, case, or medical records
blocked.description: Users, firms, roles, clients, leads, cases, case status, medical providers, medical records, treatment data, settlements, demands, custom fields, tags, and related personal-injury legal-practice records remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Access documents, deadlines, communications, AI, or financial data
blocked.description: Documents, folders, deadlines, calendar events, texts, emails, client portal content, notes, tasks, NeosAI prompts or outputs, reports, case values, costs, invoices, payments, settlement tracking, and financial records remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use status APIs, UI sessions, or partner bypass
blocked.description: Status-page APIs, partner marketing pages, arbitrary endpoints, undocumented APIs, provider consoles, browser sessions, cookies, passwords, traffic capture, scraping, reverse engineering, pagination, polling, raw responses, bulk operations, exports, writes, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider and firm review required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until Assembly Software approves Relay as a Neos integration partner, supplies the production integration contract, and the exact law firm authorizes a least-privilege connection.

runtimeSupport.description: Neos remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable before Assembly partner approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.
Neos remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable before Assembly partner approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.

providerSetup.blocker: Assembly Software publicly describes Neos as an API-driven developer platform and offers an Integration Partner Program, but the reviewed first-party public materials do not publish the complete third-party API contract Relay requires for implementation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Apply to Assembly Software's Neos Integration Partner Program and request the current partner API contract, safe-development environment, production and test origins, authorization and callback model, scopes or tenant permissions, token lifecycle, rate limits, audit and privacy obligations, test tenant, integration-vetting process, and live acceptance criteria. Then obtain explicit authorization from the exact law firm and approve a least-privilege action/data classification before implementing any connector.

evidence.supports: Assembly describes the Neos Integration Partner Program, says Neos is an API-driven developer platform, provides safe environments for development, and vets completed integrations before go-live, but does not publish auth, endpoint, scope, rate-limit, or acceptance details.

Assembly's Neos product site describes personal-injury case management across intake, documents, deadlines, settlement, reporting, NeosAI, client communication, Azure hosting, SOC 2 Type II certification, and integrations.
Assembly lists Neos features including case management, customizable case types and layouts, client communication via portal/SMS/Outlook email, AI, document management, and integrations.
Assembly describes security controls around Microsoft Azure hosting, firm data isolation, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, web application firewall protection, and data-protection certifications.

securityNotes: No Neos account, API key, token, firm identifier, client, case, medical, document, communication, AI, settlement, financial, report, or legal-practice data was collected or tested.

Assembly's public partner program and status-page API do not establish Relay authorization, a distributable authentication flow, exact tenant binding, least-privilege scopes, or production acceptance.

Relay will not use browser sessions, passwords, cookies, provider consoles, status-page APIs, traffic capture, scraping, or reverse engineering as a substitute for an Assembly-approved Neos integration contract.

All identity, client, lead, case, medical, document, calendar, task, communication, AI, settlement, billing, payment, accounting, reporting, write, administration, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export operations remain unavailable.
